evidence.quote: LW-Al0 alloy is composed of two phases, a light grey phase enriched with Ti and Nb (slightly enriched) elements, and a dark grey phase enriched with Zr, Cr, and V.

These four alloys are still composed of two phases, namely, the dark phase enriched by Ti and Nb (slightly enriched) elements and the bright phase enriched by Zr, Cr, and Al (secondarily enriched) elements.
SEM images show that volume fractions of C14 Laves phase in LW-Al0.1, LW-Al0.2, LW-Al0.3 and LW-Al0.4 alloys are 52% ± 3%, 55% ± 2%, 64% ± 1% and 53% ± 2%, respectively.
